title: KOReader
intro: Read your Books library on a Kobo, Kindle or other e-reader running KOReader: browse and download books from the device, and keep your place, finished status, highlights and reading time in sync with the browser and the apps.
step1: Download the plugin and copy the backissue.koplugin folder from the zip into KOReader's plugins folder on the device, then restart KOReader.
step2: In KOReader open the top menu, then Tools → BackIssue. The server address is already filled in; paste a personal key from API key on this page.
step3: Use Browse library to download books. Positions, highlights and reading statistics sync as you open and close books; Sync all books catches up older ones, and each kind of sync can be switched off there.
updateAvailable: {version} available, use Check for plugin update on the device
noReading: No reading time yet. It arrives after a book is closed on the device.
